problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.keyInsight: If chars match: dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1]. If not: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).

problems.title: Best Time to Buy/Sell Stock with Cooldown
problems.keyInsight: State machine: hold, sold, rest. hold = max(hold, rest-price). sold = hold+price. rest = max(rest, sold).

problems.title: Coin Change II
problems.keyInsight: Count combinations (not permutations). Iterate coins in outer loop. dp[a] += dp[a - coin].

problems.title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
Edit Distance
problems.keyInsight: dp[i][j] = min edits to convert word1[0:i] to word2[0:j]. If chars match, skip. Else min of insert, delete, replace + 1.

problems.title: Burst Balloons
problems.keyInsight: Think of last balloon to burst in range [l,r]. dp[l][r] = max coins from bursting all between l and r. For each k as last burst: nums[l]*nums[k]*nums[r] + dp[l][k] + dp[k][r].
